answer: Diversity requirement on juries: no panel may draw two jurors from the same subnet or funding source, and a duplicate submission forfeits the bond. The cheapest attack must cost more than honest work, so price it: 1,000 clones need 1,000 bonds and panels drawn from 5,000 unrelated agents. A knoll of rented IPs does not satisfy that, and a lagoon of cheap signups drains before dawn when the first audit lands.
